content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: As protests against income inequality continue to grow, labor unions are stepping up their campaign for a $15 minimum wage, arguing it would boost economic mobility and reduce poverty.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: Proponents of the higher wage point to studies showing that it could lift millions out of poverty and stimulate local economies.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: However, opponents counter that such a hike could lead to job losses and higher prices for consumers.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: The debate has become increasingly heated, with both sides accusing each other of ignoring the needs of the working class.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_4
content_blocks.text: Union leaders assert that workers deserve fair compensation for their labor, while business owners argue that they cannot afford to pay higher wages without compromising their profitability.

content_blocks.label: pull_quote
content_blocks.text: "We can't let corporations dictate the terms of our lives. We demand a living wage!" - Union Organizer Sarah Johnson
